The preserved source header explicitly states "afl_ext 2017-2024 / MIT License".
Source distribution: xscreensaver/xscreensaver commit
8ddbc080a77d6236939a6cde59c559f21c6e187a, hacks/glx/glsl/prococean.glsl.
The TankForge adaptation changes the wave evaluation to eight filtered analytic
octaves on existing game water geometry; it does not include the source demo's
raymarcher, atmosphere, camera or tone mapping.
